posts.name: Anthropic
posts.text: Applications are now open for two new Anthropic Fellowships. STEM Fellows (science and engineering) and Conceptual Reasoning Fellows (philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law) will spend four months at Anthropic from January 2027, working to help Claude reason well about some of the hardest problems in those fields. For more information, see the descriptions below. The application deadline is October 28. Conceptual Reasoning Fellows: https://t.co/kTaBPqttbK STEM Fellows: https://t.co/KkD5ruJkjq

posts.name: Google Gemini
posts.text: Plus up your furniture with 3D-printed accessories using Gemini 4 Argon. Upload a pic with rough measurements, and use Canvas in Gemini to build an interactive 3D CAD studio where you can explore styles, tweak live sliders, and export printable STLs to upgrade your space.
